title: 第5章 采购
novel_title: 长生修仙，从装备土龙鳞开始
content_zh:
林玄收回心神。

    对于【地飨】一事，他倒没有太过急迫，十五年说短不短，说长也不算长。

    有了玄府山之中的灵物，他未必不能在此之前突破至炼气后期。

    到那时再赶赴黄龙仙城，想来不会太难。

    眼下真正要紧的还是提升修为，尽快踏入炼气中期，脱去赘修之名。

    否则别说十五年后的【地飨】一事，便是三年后的婚配之限都过不去。

    ......

    次日一早，林玄洗漱一番。

    出了住处后，便往坊市中的玄符斋走去。

    如今有了【搜山】神通，他已经能看见玄府山周边地脉中藏着的诸多灵物。

    可这些灵物大多深埋山体之中，尤其是几件品阶稍高的东西，位置更深。

    若单靠双手去挖，不说会不会留下痕迹，引起其他巡山吏的怀疑。

    光是时间林玄就浪费不起。

    因此，他想到了地行符。

    地行符乃是一阶中品符箓，激发之后，可使修士短暂遁入土石之中，借地气快速穿行一大段距离。

    再加上他修得是土道功法《土元功》，对这种土道符箓有一定加成。

    因此借助地行符，就能快速抵达灵物的藏匿之处。

    且过程十分隐蔽，只需在灵物的藏匿之处开一个小洞，即可开始收集灵物。

    玄符斋距离九仙商盟不远，是一座二层小楼，门口挂着几串符幡。

    林玄进去时，里面已有几名修士正在挑选符箓。

    一名青衣伙计迎了上来，笑问道。

    “仙师想买些什么符？”

    “地行符。”

    林玄没有绕弯子，直接说道。

    伙计点了点头，转身从柜中取出一只木匣。

    “一阶中品地行符，四块灵石一张，使用后可遁入土石中短暂穿行。”

    林玄看了一眼木匣中整齐摆放的符箓。

    黄纸朱纹，符面上隐隐有土黄色灵光流动。

    林玄思索片刻。

    买完地浑石后，如今他身上只剩下十一块灵石，最多能买两张。

    不过对于当下的林玄来说已经够用了。
content_en:
Lin Xuan took back his mind.

    He is not too anxious about the [Divine Food] matter. Fifteen years is neither short nor long.

    With the spiritual objects in Xuanfu Mountain, he may not be able to break through to the late stage of Qi refining before then.

    It won't be too difficult to rush to Huanglong Fairy City by then.

    What really matters now is to improve his cultivation, enter the middle stage of Qi refining as soon as possible, and get rid of the name of superfluous cultivation.

    Otherwise, let alone the [Diyian] issue in fifteen years, even the marriage limit in three years will not be able to pass.

    ...

    Early the next morning, Lin Xuan took a shower.

    After leaving the residence, he walked to Xuanfu Zhai in Fangshi.

    Now that he has the [Soushan] magical power, he can already see many spiritual objects hidden in the ground around Xuanfu Mountain.

    But most of these spiritual objects are buried deep in the mountain, especially a few higher-grade items, which are located deeper.

    If you dig with your hands alone, it will not leave traces, which will arouse the suspicion of other mountain rangers.

    Lin Xuan couldn't afford to waste time alone.

    Therefore, he thought of the Earthly Talisman.

    The earth walking talisman is a first-level mid-grade talisman. After being activated, the monk can temporarily escape into the earth and rocks, and use the earth's energy to quickly travel a long distance.

    In addition, he has practiced the earth path technique "Tu Yuan Gong", which has certain bonuses for this earth path talisman.

    Therefore, with the help of the earth talisman, you can quickly reach the hiding place of the spiritual object.

    And the process is very hidden. You only need to open a small hole in the hiding place of the spiritual objects to start collecting the spiritual objects.

    Xuan Fu Zhai is not far from the Nine Immortals Merchant Alliance. It is a two-story building with several strings of talisman flags hanging at the door.

    When Lin Xuan entered, there were several monks inside who were selecting talismans.

    A man in green clothes came up to him and asked with a smile.

    "What kind of talismans do you want to buy, Master Immortal?"

    "Earth Talisman."

    Lin Xuan said directly without beating around the bush.

    The man nodded, turned around and took out a wooden box from the cabinet.

    "A first-level middle-grade earth walking talisman, four spiritual stones per piece. After use, you can escape into the earth and rocks for a short period of time."

    Lin Xuan glanced at the neatly arranged talismans in the wooden box.

    The yellow paper has red lines, and there is a faint flow of earth-yellow spiritual light on the surface of the talisman.

    Lin Xuan thought for a moment.

    After buying the Earthly Stones, he now only has eleven spiritual stones left on him, and he can buy two at most.

    But it is enough for Lin Xuan at the moment.
